messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@truserve.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@truserve.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: Post-call: Alpha evaluation — integration roadmap & API routing asks

Hi Liam / Priya — thanks again for the hour today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Key outcomes
- TruServe wants to validate a low-latency recommendation pipeline using Redwood hosted endpoints (alpha model family) across a 2-week evaluation window.
- Primary success criteria: 95th percentile inference latency < 120ms for 128-token requests; end-to-end accuracy uplift of recommender ranking > 6% on your evaluation set vs baseline; cost per inference under $0.015.

Immediate asks from TruServe (per call)
1) Provide a short integration checklist for engineering (SDK routes, streaming vs non-streaming, auth).
2) Confirm which API routes we should use for batched scoring vs single-item streaming.
3) Share a proposed timeline and owners so both teams can sync on kickoff.

What we'll deliver by EOD tomorrow from Redwood
- Lightweight integration checklist (steps + sample SDK code). Attached: redwood-sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx
- Mutual action plan (MAP) draft with milestones — attached TRS-MAP-v1.0.pdf
- Proposed default routes: /v1/stream/generate for live scoring with streaming, /v1/batch/score for bulk jobs. We will include function-calling examples for downstream enrichment.

Proposed kickoff timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP and test account credentials.
- Week 1: spike integration — get streaming route consuming sample payloads, verify KV cache behavior.
- Week 2: closed-loop evaluation on 50k requests, collect latency + quality metrics, prepare short readout.

Owner points of contact
- Redwood eng lead: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.ai) — SDK/integration owner
- Redwood sales/ops: Marissa Cole — program lead and escalation
- TruServe eng: Liam O'Connor — integration owner

Please reply with any edits to success criteria or timeline. Happy to hop on a 30-min sync if you'd prefer to walk through the MAP.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.coole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0189

Date: 2027-07-20T17:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Alpha evaluation — integration roadmap & API routing asks

Marissa — great summary, thanks. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: the accuracy uplift target (6%) is negotiable — we'll run an initial baseline run and set the bar based on population deciles. Can we make the evaluation gate ">= 6% in top-20% segment OR no degradation in bottom-50%"? That would reduce risk for us.
- Latency: 120ms 95th is aggressive but achievable if we use hosted streaming and enable prefix caching. We'll ask infra to mirror expected payload sizes (avg 90 tokens).
- Cost target: we need a cap — can Redwood provide a short cost estimator for the expected 50k request window with suggested batching disabled vs enabled?

Next steps from TruServe
- We'll hand over a 2k sample request set tomorrow (sanitized) for the spike.
- Liam to confirm engineering availability for a Tuesday spike (ETA Tue 7/27).

If Redwood can return the MAP with inline owners and a short code sample for streaming + function calls, we can lock the kickoff.

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor | Director, Engineering — TruServe
liam.oconnor@truserve.com

Thanks — updated plan and owners below. I've attached a compact integration checklist (embedded in the Drive link) and a short code snippet here for immediate use.

Proposed owners / deliverables
- SDK quickstart (node/python): Karthik (owner) — due 2027-07-22T18:00-04:00
- Cost estimate: Ben (owner) — due 2027-07-22T16:00-04:00
- Test plan & Slack channel: Stephanie (owner) — due 2027-07-22T15:00-04:00

Lightweight streaming example (node):
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const stream = client.stream.generate({ route: '/v1/stream/generate', model: 'alpha-v0', input: { prompt: 'score: [user context] -> candidates' } });
stream.on('token', t => process.stdout.write(t));
stream.on('done', () => console.log('stream complete'));

API routing notes
- Live scoring (low-latency): /v1/stream/generate with prefix caching enabled. Use per-customer auth and a 50ms batching window if you can tolerate micro-batching.
- Bulk evaluation: /v1/batch/score with CSV ingest to S3 and callback webhook for results.
- Function calling: include a functions object in the streaming payload to call external enrichment (e.g., user-profile lookup) — we recommend making these sidecar calls asynchronous for the evaluation to avoid tail latency bias.

Attachments: added redwood-sdk-quickstart.md to Drive and updated TRS-MAP-v1.1.pdf with owners and dates.

Next: Marissa will confirm the Tue 7/27 spike schedule once TruServe confirms their eng availability and shares the 2k sample.
